transcript.text: Let me search for the relevant SailPoint ISC tools for sources and aggregation.
Now let me get the full details on all three key operations in parallel.

Here's the full walkthrough — four API calls in sequence.

---

## Step 1 — Get an Access Token

All ISC API calls use OAuth2 bearer tokens. Exchange your PAT credentials at the token endpoint. Note: params go in the **request body**, never the query string.

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID
&client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
```

Save the `access_token` from the response — you'll use it in all subsequent calls as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

---

## Step 2 — Create the Source

`POST /v3/sources` creates the source definition. The three required body fields are `name`, `owner`, and `connector`.

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/sources
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "My LDAP Source",
  "description": "Corporate LDAP directory",
  "owner": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "id": "<owner-identity-id>",
    "name": "Jane Admin"
  },
  "connector": "active-directory",
  "connectorClass": "sailpoint.connector.ADLDAPConnector",
  "connectorAttributes": {
    "host": "ldap.example.com",
    "port": "636"
  },
  "authoritative": false,
  "deleteThreshold": 10
}
```

> **Tip:** If you want a CSV/Delimited File source instead, add the query param `?provisionAsCsv=true` — don't try to set `type` directly in the body, it won't work correctly.

The response body includes the new source's `id` — save it as `SOURCE_ID`.

---

## Step 3 — Kick Off Account Aggregation

This is a beta endpoint, so you **must** include the `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true` header or the request will be rejected.

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/sources/{SOURCE_ID}/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

# Body fields (all optional):
# disableOptimization=true   — forces a full aggregation instead of delta
# file=@accounts.csv         — only needed for CSV/file-based sources
```

For a connector-based source (LDAP, AD, etc.) you send no body at all — ISC reaches out to the connector to pull accounts live.

The response includes a task/aggregation object with an `id` — save it as `AGGREGATION_ID`.

---

## Step 4 — Poll Aggregation Status

Also beta, so include the experimental header again. This returns counts of NEW, CHANGED, and DELETED accounts processed so far.

```bash
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/account-aggregations/{AGGREGATION_ID}/status
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
```

Poll this until the job completes. The response tells you how many accounts have been processed and what changed relative to the previous aggregation run.

---

## Required Scope

Both the source creation and the aggregation trigger require `idn:sources:manage`. Your PAT must be issued with that scope, or the token must belong to an `ORG_ADMIN`, `SOURCE_ADMIN`, or `SOURCE_SUBADMIN` user.

---

## Rate Limits

ISC enforces **100 requests per token per 10 seconds**. If you hit a `429`, back off for the duration in the `Retry-After` response header.

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/sources
    api_version: v3
  - method: POST
    path: /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
    api_version: beta
  - method: GET
    path: /beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status
    api_version: beta
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token (client credentials grant via PAT)
required_scopes: [idn:sources:manage]
key_parameters: [name, owner, connector, connectorAttributes, sourceId, disableOptimization, file, id]
```
